leads.name: Bosco di Santa Teresa cork oaks
leads.reason: Register sheets 20/B180/BR/16 (40.543217,17.921633, h 10.5 m) and 21/B180/BR/16 (40.53825,17.918517, h 9 m), no girth, no age. Reserve (Riserva naturale regionale Boschi di Santa Teresa e dei Lucci, near Tuturano) has no published public trail or entry rule found; Komoot cycling claim is third-party, Wandelweb says no hiking routes. No photo or confirmed pin. Lead: approx pin, access unconfirmed; ecologia@provincia.brindisi.it was the only contact the heritage page named.

leads.name: Pignicella cork oaks (cluster of 6)
leads.reason: Sheets 01,02,06,07,09,10/B180/BR/16 on Masseria Pignicella, girths 540, 430, 460, 465, 460 cm, h 10.5-15.5 m, coords 40.5959-40.5993,17.8901-17.9022 (biggest 40.598942,17.898017). Private masseria land; no source says visitors may enter or see them from a public road. Not public: blocked unless an access source appears. Strongest cork-oak cluster in the province if ever opened.

leads.name: Masseria Albanesi cork oak
leads.reason: Sheet 05/B180/BR/16, g410 h9.5, 40.573744,17.866614. Private masseria, no access source, no photo.

leads.name: Masseria Masina cork oak
leads.reason: Sheet 08/B180/BR/16, h12.5, no girth, 40.598803,17.886375. Private masseria, no access source.

leads.name: Masseria Cerrito cork oaks
leads.reason: Sheets 17,18,19/B180/BR/16, g400, g485, no girth, 40.5502-40.5511,17.8986-17.9013. Private masseria, no access source.

leads.name: Masseria Paticchi cork oak grove
leads.reason: Sheet 22/B180/BR/16 is a homogeneous group (insieme omogeneo), no girth, 40.562319,17.910086: grove not a single collectible tree, private masseria.

leads.name: Torre Regina Giovanna holm oak
leads.reason: Sheet 23/B180/BR/16, g415 h12.5, 40.694042,17.797136 on the coast north-west of Brindisi. Searches found nothing naming the tree and no access information for the spot; no photo, register coordinate only. No source confirms a public place to stand.

leads.name: Tuturano Valonia oak
leads.reason: Sheet 24/B180/BR/16, g305 h25 (a 25 m height for a 3 m girth oak looks implausible, possible register error), 40.535433,17.944103. Rare species this far north of Tricase; searches found no source naming it or access. No photo. Worth a session with a photo or a GPS fix.

leads.name: Mesagne Masseria Torricella oak
leads.reason: Sheet 01/F152/BR/16, g350 h18, 40.549214,17.863967. Private masseria, no access source. About 20 min by road from Brindisi.

leads.name: Mesagne Mondo Nuovo oak
leads.reason: Sheet 02/F152/BR/16, g400 h18, 40.535267,17.839867, Via San Donaci. Rural, no access source.

leads.name: Mesagne Corti Vecchie oak hybrid
leads.species: Oak hybrid (Quercus virgiliana x Q. amplifolia)
leads.reason: Sheet 03/F152/BR/16, g310 h10.5, 40.542108,17.813458, Masseria Corti Vecchie on SP74. Flagged urban in register but a masseria; no access source, modest size.

leads.name: Latiano Masseria Scaracci cork oak
leads.reason: Sheet 01/E471/BR/16, g590 h13, 40.620064,17.68275. Largest cork girth in the province; private masseria, searches found no visitor information. Lead, needs an access source.

leads.name: Latiano Villa Pigna holm oak
leads.reason: Sheet 02/E471/BR/16, g400 h12.5, 40.550683,17.725683, Via Giovanni Carbone, flagged urban. Searches found nothing showing Villa Pigna is a public garden. Lead until an access source appears.

leads.name: Latiano Masseria Grottole oak
leads.reason: Sheet 04/E471/BR/16, g420 h12.5, 40.584922,17.697422. Private masseria, no access source.

leads.name: Torre Guaceto juniper (Carovigno)
leads.reason: MASAF and Puglia register 01/B809/BR/16, 40.7176,17.783, h4.5 m, no girth. Inside the Torre Guaceto reserve, about 25 km from Brindisi; a juniper shrub-tree, not a girth/age case, no source for a visitable named individual. Lead only.

leads.name: Brindisi unregistered public old trees (Lungomare Regina Margherita, Santa Maria del Casale, Parco del Cillarese)
leads.reason: Ten-minute search in Italian found no source naming any old or remarkable tree on the seafront, at Santa Maria del Casale or in other public gardens; nothing to lead. Not mined further.
